questions.prompt: A server endpoint hides an admin button from ordinary users. What else is required?
options: Enforce a server-side permission check for every privileged operation.
Trust the browser or model to enforce the policy without server checks.
Run an unrestricted test against a public target to see what happens.
Capture live secrets in the evidence so the result is easier to reproduce.
questions.answer_key: Enforce a server-side permission check for every privileged operation.
questions.explanation: The UI does not enforce authorization; the server must decide every request.

questions.prompt: What does the same-origin policy primarily restrict?

Run an unrestricted test against a public target to see what happens.
questions.answer_key: Certain cross-origin browser reads and interactions between documents/resources.
questions.explanation: It is a browser security boundary, not a complete server-side access-control system.
